prompt: Vertical 9:16 long-lens street photo at dusk, styled like the attached image: crowded avenue, towers fading into haze, orange traffic-light bokeh. Among blurred passers-by of every age, one figure pin-sharp, a baggy beige thrift-shop suit, trousers too short, a battered tan fedora over a black balaclava, shoulders slumped, pushing a foam-headed microphone at the lens. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. 200mm f/2.8, a passing shoulder blurring the foreground, no signs or text. Thanks.
